HSTS-001.rationale: OWASP ASVS 9.2.1 — HSTS required on all HTTPS responses

HSTS-002.rationale: max-age below 1 year weakens HSTS guarantees

CSP-004.rationale: Wildcard source allows script from any host

CSP-006.rationale: object-src not restricted — plugin injection risk

XCTO-001.rationale: MIME sniffing enables content-type confusion attacks

REF-001.rationale: Weak referrer policy leaks URL to third parties

CACHE-001.rationale: Cached cookie-setting responses expose session data

COOK-001.rationale: OWASP ASVS 3.4.1 — Secure flag required on HTTPS

COOK-002.rationale: OWASP ASVS 3.4.2 — HttpOnly prevents JS cookie theft

COOK-004.rationale: Informational — modern browsers default missing SameSite to Lax automatically

SUB-001.rationale: Domain-wide cookie scope lets subdomain attacker steal main-domain session

SUB-002.rationale: CSP wildcard subdomain trust allows XSS pivot from any compromised subdomain

SUB-003.rationale: CORS trusts subdomain origin — credentialed API data exposed cross-subdomain

SUB-004.rationale: Page frameable by subdomains — postMessage confusion / clickjacking pivot

SUB-005.rationale: Sensitive cookies lack __Host- prefix — vulnerable to Cookie Tossing from subdomains

SUB-006.rationale: Missing Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy allows window.opener manipulation from subdomains

SUB-007.rationale: Missing Origin-Agent-Cluster allows document.domain relaxation cross-subdomain

SUB-008.rationale: Informational — Subdomain isolated with no trust bridges to main domain
